/bin/bash -lc 'for f in README.md package.json src/server.js src/files.js migrations/003_remove_audit.sql tests/smoke.js; do echo "--- $f ---"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "set -o pipefail
printf '%s\\n' '--- git status ---'
git status --short
printf '%s\\n' '--- dependency/build metadata ---'
npm test
printf '%s\\n' '--- node path behavior ---'
node --input-type=module -e \"import {requestedFile} from './src/files.js'; for (const n of ['report.txt','../../etc/passwd','/etc/passwd','..','']) console.log(JSON.stringify(n), '=>', requestedFile(n))\"
printf '%s\\n' '--- server smoke ---'
node src/server.js >/tmp/small-file-service.log 2>&1 & svc="'$!
trap '"'kill \""'$svc" 2>/dev/null || true'"' EXIT
sleep 0.3
for args in \\
  '-i http://127.0.0.1:8080/?name=report.txt' \\
  '-i -H \"x-admin-token: admin\" \"http://127.0.0.1:8080/?name=report.txt\"' \\
  '-i -H \"x-admin-token: admin\" \"http://127.0.0.1:8080/?name=../../etc/passwd\"'; do echo \"CMD curl "'$args"; eval "curl -sS $args" || true; echo; done
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- server log ---'
sed -n '1,80p' /tmp/small-file-service.log"

/bin/bash -lc "set +e
printf '%s\\n' '--- syntax checks ---'
node --check src/server.js; s1="'$?
node --check src/files.js; s2=$?
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- tests ---'
npm test; s3="'$?
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- build command ---'
npm run build; s4="'$?
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- tracked-looking workspace files ---'
find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path './.git/*' -not -path './ASSESSMENT.md' -printf '%p\\n' | sort
printf 'statuses syntax_server=%s syntax_files=%s tests=%s build=%s\\n' \""'$s1" "$s2" "$s3" "$s4"
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- assessment preview ---'
sed -n '1,240p' ASSESSMENT.md"
